Implementation complete. Summary of what I changed in `/workspace/cocos2d-x/cocos/physics/CCPhysicsBody.cpp`:

**`addShape`** — now accumulates `_area`, calls `addMass(shape->getMass())` / `addMoment(shape->getMoment())` (the sentinel handling lives inside those two, which is what makes `createEdgeXXX` bodies end up with `PHYSICS_INFINITY` mass/moment as the header documents), registers the shape's `cpShape`s with the world via `_world->addShape(shape)` when `_world != nullptr`, then `_shapes.pushBack(shape)` (which retains).

**`setMass` / `addMass` / `addMoment`** — fixed three real defects: density was set to `0` instead of `PHYSICS_INFINITY` for an infinite mass; the `mass == PHYSICS_INFINITY` / `moment == PHYSICS_INFINITY` branch was missing entirely (only `-PHYSICS_INFINITY` was handled), so `_mass += FLT_MAX` would overflow past the sentinel; and neither function synced the Chipmunk body. Now `internalBodySetMass(_cpBody, _mass)` runs when `_dynamic`, and `cpBodySetMoment(_cpBody, _moment)` when `_rotationEnabled && _dynamic` — matching the existing guards in `setMoment`/`setDynamic`.

**`beforeSimulation`** — applies scale/rotation only on change, transforms `_ownerCenterOffset` through `nodeToWorldTransform` to get the body's world position, calls `setPosition`, records it, and for non-middle anchor points computes `_offset` as center-minus-anchor in *parent* space via `parentToWorldTransform.getInversed()`.

**`afterSimulation`** — reads the simulated position back, and only when it actually moved converts it into parent space and writes `_owner->setPosition(x - _offset.x, y - _offset.y)`. Rotation now uses `getRotation()` (which refreshes `_recordedRotation` from `cpBodyGetAngle`) instead of the stale `_recordedRotation`.

**`onAdd`** — uses `setRotationOffset(_owner->getRotation())` so the cpBody angle is actually updated, and calls `addToPhysicsWorld()` (components can be added after `onEnter`).

**`addToPhysicsWorld` / `removeFromPhysicsWorld`** — were only assigning `_world` directly; they now call `scene->getPhysicsWorld()->addBody(this)` and `_world->removeBody(this)`, which is what sets `_world` and queues the cpBody/cpShapes into the `cpSpace`.

Every Chipmunk call and cocos member I used is either already present elsewhere in this file (`internalBodySetMass`, `cpBodySetMoment`) or verified in `CCNode.h`, `CCScene.h`, `Mat4.h`, `Vec2.h`, `Vec3.h`, `CCVector.h`, `CCPhysicsWorld.h`, `CCPhysicsShape.h`.
